payload.body:
START, light (dc, Utilz, todo 18): the kovacs readback of 2.14.2's keg, then dc's two /var/tmp tool dirs on kovacs removed. The slot is yours to number.
- Where: kovacs over ssh (ssh config's kovacs, BatchMode), no checkout there; on the Mac, ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/ only, nothing in the primary.
- What it reads: brew's keg of utilz 2.14.2 (tag 2.14.2 on release commit 54b6262d), with VERSION 2.14.2 and COMMIT7 54b6262. Every line it quotes from 2.14.1's code stands, since each file it quotes is unchanged between the two tags; two new rows want menuz 0.4.7 and prez 2.5.9, the versions 2.14.2 moved, read from the tag's opt/menuz/VERSION and opt/prez/crate/Cargo.toml.
- Command 1: /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/readback/kv-readback.sh rb2142 (c0e7bf15dcf6). It makes a mktemp -d run dir /var/tmp/dc-readback-rb2142.XXXXXX on kovacs, copies kv-readback-remote.sh (23e128a2538a) there and runs it, brings its logs back to readback/rb2142/ and removes the run dir. On kovacs each command runs under timeout 120, stdin from /dev/null, the keg's links first on PATH, XDG homes and TMPDIR in the run dir; it refuses off Linux. Kill: a perl alarm of 600 s on the ssh run.
- Command 2, after command 1 whatever its result: ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/run-pgroup.sh 120 /bin/bash ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-dc/work/kv-rm-tooldirs.sh (d72ba6217fd0; run-pgroup.sh e6412488ee5f). It removes /var/tmp/dc-2141-sc090.qyz5IL and /var/tmp/dc-2141-lua.dXTRHg, each named in full and required to be a plain directory of kovacs's ssh user, sized, removed and read back absent; nothing else.
- Binds and starts: nothing; no build, GUI, daemon or port; its own run dir only, removed after. 2.14.1's copies sit beside the new ones for the diff: kv-readback-remote.sh.2141 (290ce6da3b00) and kv-readback.sh.2141 (b2d4eef16cc2).
- Expected: command 1 exit 0 with no FAIL row: utilz:2.14.2, installed at /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/utilz/2.14.2/libexec (54b6262, CI ...); the keg's link first on the login PATH; doctor's Linux rows and 0083's refusals as in slot 202; utilz:2.14.2/menuz:0.4.7 and utilz:2.14.2/prez:2.5.9; nothing written under $HOME. Command 2 exit 0, both dirs removed.
- GO when: hv has pushed the tap, kovacs's keg reads 2.14.2 (kovacs-sysadm's upgrade on hv's approval), and intent-vc has the kovacs gap free.
- The END, to you: each FAIL row by name and the totals, brew list's versions, the version and login rows, the outside rows, command 2's lines, and the logs' path.
